📦 CONTENT PACKAGE — week of 21–25 Oct 2026

This week: 3 posts + 2 Stories.
• Wed 21 Oct, 18:30 — Reel (Diskon 35%)
• Fri 23 Oct, 18:30 — Feed post (Diskon 35%)
• Sun 25 Oct, 11:00 — Carousel (taste story)
• Story with link sticker on Wed and Fri

Each post below: the file(s) → the caption to copy → how to post.
Save files to your phone: tap the file → ⋯ → Save to Photos/Files.

⚙️ FIRST, ONCE: Instagram bio link
Edit profile → Links → set your website link to:
https://jentiskitchen.id/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=bio&utm_campaign=organic-oct26
(This tag lets the reports count orders coming from your Instagram bio.)

━━━━━━━━━━
1️⃣ WED 21 OCT, 18:30 — REEL
Files: the video + its cover image ↓

Antre lama, waktu dibatasi… mending BBQ di rumah 🔥

DISKON 35% untuk pembelian pertama!* Daging BBQ marinasi siap panggang — full daging, tanpa lemak. Manis atau Asin Gurih, kamu pilih 😋

Klaim di jentiskitchen.id — link di bio 👆
*Untuk akun baru, maks. potongan Rp100.000, khusus produk.

#jentiskitchen #diskon #promomakanan #dagingmarinasi #bbqdirumah #bbqjakarta #koreanbbqdirumah #frozenfoodjakarta #kulinerjakarta #masakdirumah

How to post the Reel:
1. Instagram → + → Reel → pick the video.
2. Tap 🎵 Audio → choose a trending song (one with the ↗ arrow), upbeat, e.g. search “cooking” or “food vlog”. Start it so the beat lands when the 35% ticket appears.
3. Next → Edit cover → Add from camera roll → pick the cover image.
4. Paste the caption. Add location: Jakarta.
5. Keep “Also share to Feed” ON → Share.
6. Right after: open the Reel → paper-plane icon → “Add to story”.

How to post the Story:
1. Instagram → + → Story → pick the Story KV.
2. Sticker icon → LINK → paste:
https://jentiskitchen.id/register?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=story&utm_campaign=discount-oct26
3. Tap “Customise sticker text” → type: KLAIM DISKON 35%
4. Place the sticker just under the orange button (not over the 35% ticket).
5. Share. Optional: also post it again on Fri.

🔥 DISKON 35% untuk pembelian pertama!*

Daging BBQ marinasi siap panggang dari Jenti's Kitchen — full daging, tanpa lemak, sudah dibumbui. Lebih nikmat dari AYCE, tanpa antre dan tanpa batas waktu.

Manis atau Asin Gurih? Kamu pilih 😋

Cara klaim:
1️⃣ Daftar akun di jentiskitchen.id
2️⃣ Voucher 35% langsung masuk ke akunmu
3️⃣ Pakai saat checkout

Link di bio 👆
*Untuk akun baru, maks. potongan Rp100.000, khusus produk.

#jentiskitchen #diskon #promomakanan #dagingmarinasi #bbqdirumah #bbqjakarta #koreanbbqdirumah #frozenfoodjakarta #kulinerjakarta #masakdirumah

How to post:
1. Instagram → + → Post → pick the image.
2. Tap the crop icon (⤢) so the full 4:5 image shows — nothing cut off.
3. Next → paste the caption → location: Jakarta → Share.
4. Pin it: open the post → ⋯ → Pin to your profile (it’s your offer post).
5. Post the Story KV again with the link sticker the same evening.

━━━━━━━━━━
3️⃣ SUN 25 OCT, 11:00 — CAROUSEL (4 slides)
Files in this order: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 ↓

Lebih nikmat dari AYCE, tanpa antre dan tanpa batas waktu. 🔥

Daging BBQ marinasi Jenti's Kitchen: full daging, tanpa lemak, sudah dibumbui — tinggal panggang atau goreng di rumah.

Manis atau Asin Gurih? Dua-duanya bikin nagih.

🎁 Daftar akun baru di jentiskitchen.id → langsung dapat voucher diskon 35% untuk pembelian pertama (maks. Rp100.000, khusus produk).

Pesan sekarang: link di bio 👆

#jentiskitchen #dagingmarinasi #bbqdirumah #bbqjakarta #koreanbbqdirumah #frozenfoodjakarta #kulinerjakarta #makananbeku #masakdirumah

How to post:
1. Instagram → + → Post → tap “Select multiple” → pick slides 1, 2, 3, 4 IN THAT ORDER.
2. Crop icon → keep the full 4:5 size.
3. Next → paste the caption → location: Jakarta → Share.

━━━━━━━━━━
✅ AFTER EVERY POST
• Reply to every comment in the first hour (Instagram shows active posts to more people).
• Answer DMs asking “how to order” with: jentiskitchen.id — daftar akun dulu ya kak, voucher 35% langsung masuk 🙏
• Tell me in our chat if a post got many comments or questions — I’ll use it for next week.

The paid ads run separately; you don’t need to boost these posts.
